decided_by: maintainer 2026-11-04 (review of a143b7ed), section 4: 'T2507 independent L40S device admission plus formal tool_generation' -- in the same formal session, a minimal GPU admission on the real teacher revision, tokenizer, chat template, vLLM lock, the 8,184 context and a representative generation path; continue when it passes; no CPU-only rehearsal and no full pilot; the L40S by default, an A100 only on a measured out-of-memory
why: the generation-scoped L40S gate (l40s_check.generation_scope_problems) measured the hybrid's engine and refuses Thinking-2507 (another model, revision and chat template), so no committed record says this teacher's generation fits the card at the session limit; this admission measures it inside the formal session instead of a separate check

teacher._chat_template_sha256: sha256 of tokenizer.chat_template (run_battery's rule); the value teacher_identity.json :: historical_teacher and reasoning_data/generation_protocol.json register for this revision
teacher._source: 2026-11-04 UTC: the hub's tree at this revision (api/models/Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507/tree/768f209d; git blob ids and LFS sha256 with sizes) agrees with the dev box's cached snapshot, whose every cached file's content hashes to its blob name; the per-file sha256 above are those files' contents. The tokenizer_sha256 3ec3c124... that corpus_v2's manifest recorded uses a convention not reproducible from these files (it is not the concatenation of tokenizer*.json, 432738f6...), so the admission checks each tokenizer file instead

engine._vllm_version: requirements-vllm.txt's pin (vllm==0.27.1); the pod checks the runner's recorded engine version against the pin it reads from that file
engine._session_limit: tool_generation_protocol.json :: execution.session_limit; the runner's session_limit, effective_limit and the engine's max_model_len must all equal it

memory.rule: the GPU sampler's peak memory.used over the admission invocation leaves at least that much of memory.total free; a CUDA out-of-memory line in the engine log, or an engine that never reports its KV cache, fails

tasks.rule: the first task of every cell of the lineage's mode, in the plan's cell order (its task_ids, the frozen order): one per category and the validation cell
tasks.candidate: pass 0 only, at the protocol's seed base
tasks.outputs: device evidence only, under <out>/device_admission/: never sealed under a formal label, never imported, admitted, counted or packed; the formal rounds generate every task of the plan, these included

on_failure: the session ends RUN_FAILED before any formal invocation, with the measured evidence; an ordinary failure of the mechanism is repaired inside the same cumulative $2.78; an A100 only after a measured CUDA out-of-memory on the L40S and a separate authorization
authorizes: nothing by itself: the grant's tool_generation_t2507 block authorizes the session

registered_result.measured: all 15 criteria passed on an L40S (US-TX-4): engine ready 157.9 s, KV cache 195,009 tokens at the 8,184 session limit, peak 37,611 of 46,068 MiB (8.26 GiB free), vLLM 0.27.1
registered_result.reuse: maintainer 2026-11-05 (review of f06ccd4), section 1: '相同 Teacher、revision、引擎依赖和合规 GPU 环境下，可以复用已登记的设备适配证据；新 Pod 仍须实际确认能加载和运行，不必无意义地重复完整的八任务准入采样'. A later session with the same teacher, revision, chat template, vLLM pin and session limit (tool_session.registered_device_admission) does not sample the admission's tasks: it hashes the teacher snapshot before any invocation and applies device_verdict to its first formal invocation (tool_session.device_confirmation); a failed verdict ends the session and that invocation's shards are not imported
